goal: Explain the study plan, financial picture, gaps, refusals, document issues, or any concern that needs clarification.

structure.instruction: State the purpose of the letter clearly.
Identify the application and the reason for the letter.
Address the concern directly and chronologically.
Restate that the explanation is complete and consistent.

red_flags: Saying the letter is only a formality
Trying to hide a problem instead of explaining it
Unsupported claims about bank balances, sponsors, or employment
Copy-paste wording from templates without personalization
banned_phrases: I am sure my visa will be approved
I have no documents but please consider me
Canada is my only way out

preferred_replacements.rich enough: as detailed in the attached financial proof

quality_checklist: The explanation is factual and brief
